title: Foundational Autoraters: Taming Large Language Models for Better Automatic Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the CoBBLEr benchmark to test robustness against changes in pairwise ordering (order bias), specific model naming (compassion bias), self-generated text (egocentric bias), peer pressure statements (bandwagon bias), and irrelevant context (attention bias).

Measuring the preference for longer or shorter outputs using the length metric in the CoBBLEr benchmark, as well as calculating the percentage of preference for longer outputs across different categories in the RewardBench dataset.
Analyzing the frequency of specific words and phrases (e.g., 'sorry', 'i', 'can') predominantly found in preferred versus rejected model responses in the RewardBench benchmark.
